name: VesselPortal
description: A networked.art renderer that builds a token's metadata from artwork already stored on The Vessel.
about:
VesselPortal is an `IRenderer` for the [networked.art](https://networked.art) protocol. Instead of storing an artwork's bytes in the token, a token stores a *reference* to bytes that already live on-chain in [The Vessel](https://thevessel.fun), and this contract assembles the metadata at view time.

A token is two `Source`s — a poster (the still `image`) and an animation (`animation_url`) — resolved the same way:

| kind | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | The Vessel. Pinned entries (0-based) concatenate in the order given; empty follows the holder's live payload. |
| 1 | The Relics contract. Pinned relic entries are 1-based and vault-relics only. |
| 2 | Inline bytes carried in the artifact itself. |

Because either half can be a reference, a fully referenced mint is a few hundred bytes of artifact serving an artwork of any size, and a work sharded across many vault slots reassembles in the order its entries are listed.

**`uri()` can never revert.** On networked.art, renderer registration is append-only and a token's renderer index is fixed at mint, so a renderer that can fail is a renderer that can brick a collector's token permanently. The poster and animation degrade independently and the metadata carries `"unresolved":true` when either fails. The strict entry points (`animationURI`, `resolveSource`, `resolveArtifact`) revert loudly instead, so minting tools discover problems before signing.

Metadata carries `"mutable":true` whenever a source resolves through a path a third party can change — a live vault payload follows the *holder's* chosen slot, and the holder need not be the collector.

The contract is immutable, ownerless and stateless: no admin, no upgrade path, no storage, and every function is `view` or `pure`. It holds nothing and can move nothing. One deployment serves every collection and every artist; registering it costs one transaction per collection.
risks: Immutable and unowned — no admin, no upgrade path, and nothing can be corrected after deployment.
A live (unpinned) source follows the vessel holder's chosen entry, so its artwork can change after mint.
Relic entries stay curator-editable; pinning one pins the index, not the bytes.
Poster and animation share a 128 KB content budget; past it a token renders its thumbnail only.
Registering a renderer on a collection is append-only and the index is fixed at mint.

MAX_CONTENT_BYTES.title: Content Budget
MAX_CONTENT_BYTES.description: Total bytes the poster and animation may resolve to between them.

MAX_ENTRIES.title: Entry Limit
MAX_ENTRIES.description: Most vault entries a single source may concatenate.

MAX_CHUNKS.title: Chunk Limit
MAX_CHUNKS.description: Most SSTORE2 pointers a token's artifact may span.

MAX_READ_BYTES.title: Read Limit
MAX_READ_BYTES.description: Most bytes copied from any single external read.

MAX_TEXT_BYTES.title: Text Limit
MAX_TEXT_BYTES.description: Most bytes accepted for a token's name or description.

READ_GAS.title: Read Gas Cap
READ_GAS.description: Gas allowed for a general external read, so a hostile callee cannot burn the caller's gas.

SOURCE_READ_GAS.title: Source Read Gas Cap
SOURCE_READ_GAS.description: Gas allowed for a single entry or payload read.

FALLBACK_MIME.title: Fallback Media Type
FALLBACK_MIME.description: Media type substituted when a source declares one this renderer will not serve.

KIND_VESSEL.title: Kind: Vessel
KIND_VESSEL.description: The source kind that reads The Vessel.

KIND_RELICS.title: Kind: Relics
KIND_RELICS.description: The source kind that reads the Relics contract.

KIND_INLINE.title: Kind: Inline
KIND_INLINE.description: The source kind whose bytes are carried in the artifact itself.

MalformedReference.title: Malformed Reference
MalformedReference.description: The artifact could not be decoded as a poster and animation source pair.

UnknownKind.title: Unknown Source Kind
UnknownKind.description: The source kind is not vessel, relics or inline.

NotAVault.title: Not a Vault
NotAVault.description: Pinned entries were requested from a vessel that is not a vault.

EntryOutOfRange.title: Entry Out of Range
EntryOutOfRange.description: A pinned entry index is past the end of that token's entries.

TooManyEntries.title: Too Many Entries
TooManyEntries.description: The source lists more entries than a single reference may concatenate.

TooManyChunks.title: Too Many Chunks
TooManyChunks.description: The token's artifact spans more SSTORE2 pointers than this renderer reads.

ContentTooLarge.title: Content Too Large
ContentTooLarge.description: The resolved content exceeds the budget shared by the poster and animation.

EmptyContent.title: Empty Content
EmptyContent.description: The source resolved to no bytes at all.

EmptyPointer.title: Empty Pointer
EmptyPointer.description: An SSTORE2 pointer in the artifact holds no code.

NotAContract.title: Not a Contract
NotAContract.description: A read was attempted against an address holding no code.

ReadFailed.title: Read Failed
ReadFailed.description: An external read reverted or returned nothing.

ReadBudgetExhausted.title: Read Budget Exhausted
ReadBudgetExhausted.description: A read returned more bytes than this renderer will copy.

NotSelf.title: Not Self
NotSelf.description: This function is internal to the renderer and rejects external callers.
